svg.title: LinkedIn citations by profile type in Meltwater and LinkedIn study
svg.desc: In a reported analysis of 9.5 million AI citations, individual LinkedIn member profiles accounted for 75 percent of LinkedIn citations and Company Pages accounted for 25 percent.
svg.text: Where LinkedIn AI citations came from
Meltwater and LinkedIn analysis of 9.5 million AI citations
Source: Meltwater and LinkedIn, 2026. Vendor-reported dataset; not a universal share for every platform or industry.
